q.g: Interchange is great place to go for this quest: * OLI (home improvement store) very commonly spawns car batteries and spark plugs on its shelves. * Goshan / гошан (grocery store) commonly spawns car batteries on the store shelves located south of the big fire. Drawers commonly spawn spark plugs. Reserve is a great place to loot these filing cabinets, with several in the Knight buildings, Queen building, and underground office area.
